svg.aria-label: The plan mode, detailed view. Boxes: academic-paper 3.2.0: Intake: the 3-question simplified interview (stop); Step 0 readiness check: materials and the research question; a missing foundation is sent to deep-research first (agent); Step 1 thesis: INSIGHT thesis_statement (agent); Step 2 chapters, six in order, at least 2 rounds each; a chapter summary after each (agent); Structure architect: the outline from all chapter summaries (agent); Step 2.5 contribution sharpening, at least 1 round; INSIGHT contribution_claim (agent); Step 3 stress test: socratic mentor and argument builder probe each sub-argument (agent); Chapter plan and INSIGHT collection (agent) | paper, as ruled: Intake: config.md [D24]; the plan-mode interview of the topic, the materials in hand and the structure preference (stop); Socratic mentor, started once and resumed with each answer; Step 0 refers a missing foundation to /paper lit-review and idea [4.A D5]; checkpoint.md after each round [AY] (ruled); The mentor's question: each round is a stop; its offers are to skip a chapter, switch to outline-only or pause [4.A D1] (stop); Planner, a fresh start when the mentor ends with next: outline; the outline and the argument map from the chapter summaries [AY] [4.A D16] (ruled); Socratic mentor, Step 2.5: contribution sharpening, three questions on the chapter summaries, one round or more [4.A R2-7] (ruled); Planner, a fresh start for each answer: sub-arguments rated Strong, Moderate or Weak into stress-test.md [4.A D6] (ruled); Planner, a fresh start: chapter-plan.md with the plan-to-draft gate [4.A D6] (ruled); The plan's handoff: the mentor's message and its cross-chapter observation beside the chapter plan; full mode only when the gate holds [4.A D3] [4.A R2-27] (stop); Chapter plan and INSIGHT collection (agent); At every agent start: a model other than the configured one [D47] (stop).

svg.text: academic-paper: the dialogue rounds are no stops. paper: the mentor is one agent per run, resumed with each answer, and writes the checkpoint after each round so that a continued run starts from it (AY). The stress test is the planner's rating of each answer,

text.font-family: ui-sans-serif, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: with the plan-to-draft gate in the chapter plan. academic-paper names 30 rounds in one list and 15 in another, and paper takes 30. A tag such as "[4.A D1]" names a decision of step 4.A's brief and "[4.A R2-7]" a ruling of its second repair round.
